Packing list for a week on the ice

What you actually need

  • Two pairs of gloves, because one pair will get wet on the first day.
  • A stove that you have already lit at least once at home in the cold.
  • More fuel than the calculation says, since melting snow for water consumes far more than cooking does.
The mountain does not care how carefully you packed, only whether you can still move when the weather turns.
  1. Check the forecast the evening before you leave.
  2. Tell somebody reliable exactly where you are going.
